protocol: N-ring raw-history backbone with horizon_calib; both stages trained from scratch, backbone first then frozen-backbone calibration; at most 30 sampled epochs per stage; patience 3; validation-MAE checkpoint selection.
context_policy: 720 for all 42 medium/long tasks; for 55 short tasks, largest of 192/96/48/24 no greater than median training-series length, with a floor of 24. Official forecast horizons and rolling test instances retained.
sampling: Series-balanced random training origins; every eligible series sampled each epoch; at least 50 batches of effective size 64.
sampling_percentage_definition: Sum of sampled training-window draws in one epoch across 97 tasks divided by sum of eligible training windows across those tasks. Rounded to 0.121% in the model name; task-specific fractions differ and windows can repeat. This is not unique-data coverage over the full run.
forecast_distribution: Deterministic point forecast represented as a point mass; all quantiles equal the point prediction.
